_comment: P3 part-sourcer, LUM-DTR-STROBE-A (lumina-strobe), 2026-07-28. One entry per DISTINCT orderable part; refdes counts are in qty_per_board. Every row was re-verified live through parts_search at selection time (stock/price/datasheet URL as of this run). Build quantity 6; 'price' is the unit price at the price break that qty_per_board*6 reaches. Emitters, optics, the MCPCB, the heatsink, the two off-board leaded thermistors and the harness wire are NOT here: the light engine is specified, not designed, and is not bound to LCSC stock. MountingHole_3.2mm_M3 (H1-H5) and every TP are footprints, not purchased parts.

extended_reduction_options.option: build both divider top legs from 2 x 100k 0805 (C149504, JLC Basic, already on this BOM) instead of 2 x 82k. Rth goes 9.43k -> 9.52k, still inside the ICD's 10k ADC limit; the bank and Vds dividers stay identical to each other so the Vds trip stays ratiometric. Cost: ADC0 full scale falls from 3.28 V to 2.71 V at 57 V (the operating 39.7-48 V window reads 1.89-2.29 V instead of 2.28-2.76 V), i.e. ~17 % less resolution on the bank telemetry.
extended_reduction_options.saves: one distinct Extended part number (~$3 setup, ~$0.50/board at qty 6)
extended_reduction_options.decision_owner: P4 - it changes a declared divider ratio and the firmware scale factor, so it is not a sourcing substitution

Divider ratio 6.38:1 instead of 6.35:1 -> 517 mV full scale instead of 520 mV = 2.585 A instead of 2.600 A, a -0.6 % error in the safe direction. Costs 4 extra placements.

deviations_from_architecture: U100: LM5069MM-2/NOPB replaces the TPS2490 class. TPS2490's datasheet TA is -40..+85 C, which fails the board-wide +105 C minimum. LM5069 is TJ -40..+125 C with no TA ceiling and keeps all three properties blocks.md s2.2 required (100 V GND-referenced enable, GATE held low below POR/UVLO, programmable current AND power limit). Cost +$3.53/board.

U420: MCP23008T-E/SS replaces the PCF8574 / TCA9534 class. EVERY PCF8574 and TCA9534 in stock at JLC is -40..+85 C. Cost +$1.14/board against the architecture's $0.35 estimate. P4 must handle the RESET pin and the different POR state (all pins input/high-Z, not outputs-high).
U201..U351: SN74LVC1G3157DCKR (UMW, -55..+125 C) resolves blocks.md s2.3's explicit P3 action item on the SGM3157, which is -40..+85 C. Same SC-70-6 land.
U200..U350: LM2904BIDR (-40..+125 C) rather than plain LM2904 (-40..+105 C). +$0.18/board.
Q100: IRF640NSTRLPBF (200 V) rather than the IRF540N class (100 V), so all five power FETs are one part number. Deletes an Extended part number and lifts Q100's Vds margin to 3.5x.

J200/J300: CJT A3963WV-6P (VH-series-compatible, 10 A) and A2541WV-4P, both -40..+105 C, rather than genuine JST VH/XH at -25..+85 C. This CLOSES power_tree s10.5's 'P3 must confirm a +105/+125 C housing or record a derating exception' - no exception is needed.

R100 = 0.27R, derived at P3 from the LM5069's 55 mV typical current-limit threshold (sheets.md s2.2 explicitly defers this value to P3). blocks.md's '~250 mohm if the threshold is 50 mV' was correct arithmetic for the TPS2490.

open_items.item: The hot-swap controller's fault TIMER is incompatible with power_tree s3.3's 87 %-duty current-limit regime, on BOTH candidate parts. Datasheet-verified this run: TPS2490 TIMER charges at 25 uA and sinks at 2.5 uA (10:1); LM5069 charges at 85 uA (fault detection current) and sinks at 2.5 uA (34:1). power_tree s3.3 says the limiter is in regulation ~87 % of the time whenever the board is flashing, so the timer integrates strongly positive and reaches its 4 V threshold no matter how long C_TIMER programs the cold start. LM5069-2 then enters 0.5 %-duty auto-restart (the bank effectively stops charging); LM5069-1 and TPS2490 latch off. Programming the timer longer than the 653 ms cold start is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT, exactly as power_tree s3.3 suspected - and the numbers now say it does not close. This is an architecture decision, not a sourcing substitution: no hot-swap controller in this class omits the fault timer, because the timer is what protects the external FET's SOA. Options for the architect: (a) set the limit above the natural top-up current so the limiter only engages at cold start, (b) a discrete current-limit loop with no fault timer, (c) re-shape the recharge so it is not at the limit.

The +105/+125 C rule costs +$4.85/board on two parts alone (LM5069 +$3.53 vs TPS2490; MCP23008 +$1.14 vs TCA9534). Both rejected parts are in stock, cheaper and functionally fine at the 56 C design-of-record air. If H2 re-affirms ICD s7.6's 56 C, the human may prefer to reinstate them as documented derating exceptions.

The 680uF/100V D18x25 bank is effectively SINGLE-VENDOR (Ymin). The 6-footprint / 4-populated layout is what buys the second source, and it only pays off at 470 uF, where AISHI / SamYoung / Chengx / Lelon all stock a 7.5 mm-pitch part. blocks.md s6.3 mitigation 1 (drop the two spare footprints to recover 400 mm2 of F.Cu) therefore also deletes the bank's second source - those two levers are one lever.

Protect-sheet resistor quantities (22k, 47k, 10k, 100k in 0603) are ESTIMATES. The exact values for R400-R441 come out of the trip-point arithmetic at P4, and R430-R433's UVLO threshold is trimmed from the MEASURED string voltage (max(V_string) + 1.7 V). All of these are JLC Basic, so any E24 0603/0805 1% value P4 needs adds no feeder fee - only the placement count moves.
R2 (ID_ADC bottom leg, 4.7k) is a PLACEHOLDER. The board-type code is allocated by the carrier owner and must be confirmed before P8 (requirements open question 8).

J3 and J4 are reverse-mounted THT sockets on the BOTTOM side and the bank is radial THT on the top - neither is a standard JLC top-side SMD PCBA line. requirements s7 / open question 6 default (a) hand-finishes them locally at this quantity. order_quote at P10 must not assume JLC fits them.

parts.description: -55C~+155C 100mW 150kohm 75V Thick Film Resistor +/-1% +/-100ppm/C 0603 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS
parts.role: R_PWR, the LM5069 PWR-pin power-limit programming resistor (the datasheet's 48 V worked example uses 150k). PLIM must be programmed ABOVE the 9.6 W cold-start peak - power_tree s3.3 sets it at 12 W - so the current limit stays the control and the power limit stays a ceiling. JLC Basic.

parts.role: General decoupling (C2/C5 on conn, C201.. x4 on the drive sheets, C410-C413 on protect) plus the setpoint filter capacitor C200.. x4. LOW-VOLTAGE NODES ONLY - anything in the 48 V domain uses the 100 V 0805 part instead. JLC Basic.

parts.description: 10nF 50V X7R +/-10% 0603 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS
parts.role: C3/C4 the two ADC RC reservoir capacitors (the bank divider's 9.43k source impedance sits right at the ICD's 10k ceiling and SAR sampling charge needs a local reservoir), and C400-C403 the four Vds arming blanks. JLC Basic.
